messages:
Amy Nguyen: Incoming security questionnaire (CAIQ v3) from Newbridge for the POC. Link to form: https://app.docs/newbridge/caiq. They want answers by EOD Thu. POC will run on Dedicated; potential sample data upload. Can security pick an owner? :pray:

security-bot: New intake created: INC-3257 (triage required) — https://rwd/inc/3257

Mike Torres: ack. Can you paste the specific Qs they flagged or attach the doc in thread? Also who is the buyer/contact?

Amy Nguyen: pasted snapshot in drive: https://drive.fake/newbridge/caiq_snapshot.pdf. Contact is tara@newbridge.io. Top flags: BYOK/HSM, encryption-at-rest details, subprocessors list, and data retention. POC start targeted 2026-04-15.

Julia Park: assigning to Ravi for questionnaire answers + KMS clarification. Ravi, can you take ownership? If you want a quick sync with sales we'll set one.

Ravi Singh: I can take it. Quick Q: is POC fully isolated to Dedicated (no fallback to hosted)? Need confirmation on data flows to accurately answer CAIQ sections on data residency/retention. Also confirm whether they require hardware HSM or if cloud KMS (customer-managed keys) is acceptable.

Amy Nguyen: POC is on Dedicated in us-west-2. No planned fallback to hosted. They may upload anonymized sample data. Initial ask was HSM but they said KMS could be ok depending on contract language.

Julia Park: sounds good. I'll draft initial answers for the standard controls (auth, encryption, logging) and mark BYOK/HSM as TBD. Ravi, please fill the KMS/HSM specifics and confirm subprocessors.

Ravi Singh: started a draft in the security drive: https://drive.fake/security/drafts/INC-3257. Will populate KMS/HSM text and subprocessors list by EOD tomorrow. Also request from sales: can we get their security lead on a 30m call to validate our answers?

Amy Nguyen: I can schedule. Tentative: Thu 10:00am PT with Tara + their security lead. Will confirm with attendees.

security-bot: Reminder: questionnaire SLA timer started. SLA window: 72h from assignment. Current SLA deadline (unix ts): 3342172450.

Mike Torres: FYI for sales team — if BYOK/HSM is a hard requirement expect a pricing delta: Dedicated + HSM configuration has a separate quote. Flagging now so pricing team can prep.

Amy Nguyen: noted, will flag to procurement/buyer.

Julia Park: thanks. Ravi ping me if you need infra logs, region-specific details, or audit artifacts. :thumbsup:

Ravi Singh: Got it. I'll post updates in the draft and close the intake once QA is done. Done for now.
